psc2/pskernel-lean-wasm.message:
fix(psc2): bound native i386 bootstrap thread stacks

Run #116 passed the real stage0 frontend probe, then failed creating
workers while compiling Init/Prelude.lean. Lean's native default reserves
1 GiB per thread, which exhausts native i386 virtual address space.

Use the existing LEAN_DEFAULT_THREAD_STACK_SIZE=8388608 override only in
STAGE0_LEAN_EXTRA_CXX_FLAGS, matching Lean's 8 MiB 32-bit default without
pretending native stage0 is Emscripten or disabling worker threads.
Preserve exact pins, width/SSE flags, kernel-only linking and runtime gates.

Update the exact build-flags contract and add native32/native64 pthread
regressions to the pre-build ABI gate. Under a 256 MiB address-space
budget the old default must fail with EAGAIN, while the stage0 override
and original Emscripten default must start and join four workers.

Local native64 fixtures reproduced the failure and passed the override;
actual native32 threading and the complete Prelude/sysroot build remain
mandatory CI evidence.

fix(psc2): decode native32 shell exit codes as UInt32

Run #115 reached the frontend probe without the previous missing-Init
error, but still returned failure silently. The pinned shell decodes
IO UInt32 and EIO UInt32 statuses with generic pointer unboxing. UInt32
is heap-boxed on i386, so this returns shifted address bits, not status.

Normalize both stage0/current shell.cpp through exact fail-closed source
rewrites. Use get_io_result<object_ref> plus lean_unbox_uint32 for normal
returns, preserving IO errors and reference ownership, and the typed
decoder for early option exits. Keep the real --deps gate; retain its
stdout and exact failure status instead of discarding diagnostics.

Add native32/native64 executable boxing regressions from both pinned
headers before the expensive bootstrap, plus rewrite drift/idempotence
and failure-output checks. Local native64 and isolated Clang wasm32
fixtures reproduce/preserve the expected behavior; this container cannot
execute ELF i386, so actual native32 and frontend validation require CI.

docs(psc2): align wasm rebuild guide with staged bootstrap

Replace obsolete x86_64 C-emitter guidance with the native i386 stage0
and wasm32 stage1 sysroot architecture. Document empty target package
roots for the early dependency probe, pinned multilib prerequisites,
scalar-literal normalization, and preserved kernel-only linking.

Use the package build:wasm wrapper in monorepo instructions so the
prebuilt manifest is generated, then explicitly verify it. Explain
source-commit recording and bundled API integrity behavior without
claiming signed provenance or completed runtime verification.

Retain the mandatory health, acceptance, kernel-rejection, exact parity,
and clean installed-consumer criteria. Browser/in-process work remains
outside this milestone.
